content.text: brick:AED is a class in the schema. Its label is "AED". It is a subclass of brick:Safety_Equipment.

brick:AHU is a class in the schema. Its label is "AHU". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment. It is defined as: Assembly consisting of sections containing a fan or fans and other necessary equipment to perform one or more of the following functions: circulating, filtration, heating, cooling, heat recovery, humidifying, dehumidifying, and mixing of air. Is usually connected to an air-distribution system.
brick:Ablutions_Room is a class in the schema. Its label is "Ablutions Room". It is a subclass of brick:Room. It is defined as: A room for performing cleansing rituals before prayer

brick:Absolute_Humidity_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Absolute Humidity Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Humidity_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the present state of absolute humidity

brick:Absorption_Chiller is a class in the schema. Its label is "Absorption Chiller". It is a subclass of brick:Chiller. It is defined as: A chiller that utilizes a thermal or/and chemical process to produce the refrigeration effect necessary to provide chilled water. There is no mechanical compression of the refrigerant taking place within the machine, as occurs within more traditional vapor compression type chillers.
brick:Acceleration_Time_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Acceleration Time Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Time_Setpoint.
brick:Access_Control_Equipment is a class in the schema. Its label is "Access Control Equipment". It is a subclass of brick:Security_Equipment.
brick:Access_Reader is a class in the schema. Its label is "Access Reader". It is a subclass of brick:Access_Control_Equipment.

brick:Active_Chilled_Beam is a class in the schema. Its label is "Active Chilled Beam". It is a subclass of brick:Chilled_Beam. It is defined as: A Chilled Beam with an integral primary air connection that induces air flow through the device.

brick:Active_Power_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Active Power Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Electric_Power_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the portion of power that, averaged over a complete cycle of the AC waveform, results in net transfer of energy in one direction
brick:Adjust_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Adjust Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor. It is defined as: Measures user-provided adjustment of some value
brick:Air_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Alarm.

brick:Air_Cooled_Chiller is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Cooled Chiller". It is a subclass of brick:Chiller. It is defined as: A chiller that uses air to cool the refrigerant, used in various commercial and industrial cooling applications

brick:Air_Differential_Pressure_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Differential Pressure Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Pressure_Sensor, brick:Differential_Pressure_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the difference in pressure between two regions of air

brick:Air_Differential_Pressure_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Differential Pressure Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Differential_Pressure_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the target air differential pressure between an upstream and downstream point in a air duct or conduit

brick:Air_Diffuser is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Diffuser". It is a subclass of brick:Terminal_Unit. It is defined as: A device that is a component of the air distribution system that controls the delivery of conditioned and/or ventilating air into a room
brick:Air_Enthalpy_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Enthalpy Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Enthalpy_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the total heat content of air
brick:Air_Flow_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Flow Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm related to air flow.

brick:Air_Flow_Deadband_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Flow Deadband Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Flow_Setpoint, brick:Deadband_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the size of a deadband of air flow

brick:Air_Flow_Demand_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Flow Demand Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Flow_Setpoint, brick:Demand_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the rate of air flow required for a process
brick:Air_Flow_Loss_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Flow Loss Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Flow_Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm that indicates loss in air flow.
brick:Air_Flow_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Flow Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Flow_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the rate of flow of air
brick:Air_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Flow_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets air flow

brick:Air_Flow_Setpoint_Limit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Flow Setpoint Limit". It is a subclass of brick:Limit. It is defined as: A parameter that places a lower or upper bound on the range of permitted values of a Air_Flow_Setpoint.
brick:Air_Grains_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Grains Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the mass of water vapor in air

brick:Air_Handler_Unit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Handler Unit". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment. It is defined as: Assembly consisting of sections containing a fan or fans and other necessary equipment to perform one or more of the following functions: circulating, filtration, heating, cooling, heat recovery, humidifying, dehumidifying, and mixing of air. Is usually connected to an air-distribution system.
brick:Air_Handling_Unit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Handling Unit". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment.
brick:Air_Loop is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Loop". It is a subclass of brick:Loop. It is defined as: The set of connected equipment serving one path of air

brick:Air_Plenum is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Plenum". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment. It is defined as: A component of the HVAC the receives air from the air handling unit or room to distribute or exhaust to or from the building
brick:Air_Pressure_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Pressure Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Pressure_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the pressure of the surrounding air.
brick:Air_Pressure_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Pressure Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Pressure_Setpoint.
brick:Air_Quality_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Quality Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor. It is defined as: A sensor which provides a measure of air quality

brick:Air_Static_Pressure_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Static Pressure Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Static_Pressure_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the pressure exerted by the air in a system, not influenced by its motion.
brick:Air_Static_Pressure_Step_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Static Pressure Step Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Static_Pressure_Step_Parameter.

brick:Air_System is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air System". It is a subclass of brick:Heating_Ventilation_Air_Conditioning_System. It is defined as: The equipment, distribution systems and terminals that introduce or exhaust, either collectively or individually, the air into and from the building

brick:Air_Temperature_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Temperature Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Alarm, brick:Temperature_Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm that indicates the off-normal conditions associated with the temperature of air.

brick:Air_Temperature_Integral_Time_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Temperature Integral Time Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Integral_Time_Parameter, brick:Temperature_Parameter.
brick:Air_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Temperature_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the temperature of air
brick:Air_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Temperature_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets temperature of air

brick:Air_Temperature_Setpoint_Limit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Temperature Setpoint Limit". It is a subclass of brick:Limit, brick:Temperature_Parameter. It is defined as: A parameter that places a lower or upper bound on the range of permitted values of a Air_Temperature_Setpoint.
brick:Air_Temperature_Step_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Temperature Step Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Temperature_Step_Parameter.

brick:Air_Velocity_Pressure_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Velocity Pressure Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Velocity_Pressure_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the difference between total air pressure and static air pressure.
brick:Air_Wet_Bulb_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Air Wet Bulb Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Temperature_Sensor, brick:Temperature_Sensor.

brick:Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Point. It is defined as: Alarm points are signals (either audible or visual) that alert an operator to an off-normal condition which requires some form of corrective action

brick:Alarm_Delay_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Alarm Delay Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Delay_Parameter. It is defined as: A parameter determining how long to delay an alarm after sufficient conditions have been met

brick:Alarm_Sensitivity_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Alarm Sensitivity Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Parameter. It is defined as: A parameter indicates the sensitivity to activate an alarm.
brick:Ammonia_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Ammonia Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Quality_Sensor.
brick:Angle_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Angle Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor. It is defined as: Measues the planar angle of some phenomenon
brick:Atrium is a class in the schema. Its label is "Atrium". It is a subclass of brick:Common_Space. It is defined as: a large open-air or skylight covered space surrounded by a building.

brick:Audio_Visual_Equipment is a class in the schema. Its label is "Audio Visual Equipment". It is a subclass of brick:ICT_Equipment. It is defined as: Equipment related to sound and visual components such as speakers and displays.
brick:Auditorium is a class in the schema. Its label is "Auditorium". It is a subclass of brick:Common_Space. It is defined as: A space for performances or larger gatherings
brick:Automated_External_Defibrillator is a class in the schema. Its label is "Automated External Defibrillator". It is a subclass of brick:Safety_Equipment.

brick:Automatic_Mode_Command is a class in the schema. Its label is "Automatic Mode Command". It is a subclass of brick:Mode_Command. It is defined as: Controls whether or not a device or controller is operating in "Automatic" mode

brick:Automatic_Switch is a class in the schema. Its label is "Automatic Switch". It is a subclass of brick:Switchgear. It is defined as: An automatic switch operates automatically in the event of some current threshold or other designed event. Criteria for automatic operation is generally a physical property of the switch.
brick:Automatic_Tint_Window is a class in the schema. Its label is "Automatic Tint Window". It is a subclass of brick:Shading_Equipment. It is defined as: A window with tint control.
brick:Automatic_Tint_Window_Array is a class in the schema. Its label is "Automatic Tint Window Array". It is a subclass of brick:System. It is defined as: An array of Automatic Tint Windows.

brick:Automatic_Transfer_Switch is a class in the schema. Its label is "Automatic Transfer Switch". It is a subclass of brick:Automatic_Switch, brick:Transfer_Switch. It is defined as: An automatic transfer switch (ATS) is a device that automatically transfers a power supply from its primary source to a backup source when it senses a failure or outage in the primary source.

brick:Availability_Status is a class in the schema. Its label is "Availability Status". It is a subclass of brick:Status. It is defined as: Indicates if a piece of equipment, system, or functionality is available for operation

brick:Average_Cooling_Demand_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Average Cooling Demand Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Cooling_Demand_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the average power consumed by a cooling process as the amount of power consumed over some interval

brick:Average_Discharge_Air_Flow_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Average Discharge Air Flow Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Supply_Air_Flow_Sensor. It is defined as: The computed average flow of discharge air over some interval

brick:Average_Exhaust_Air_Static_Pressure_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Average Exhaust Air Static Pressure Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Exhaust_Air_Static_Pressure_Sensor. It is defined as: The computed average static pressure of air in exhaust regions of an HVAC system over some period of time

brick:Average_Heating_Demand_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Average Heating Demand Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Heating_Demand_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the average power consumed by a heating process as the amount of power consumed over some interval

brick:Average_Supply_Air_Flow_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Average Supply Air Flow Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Supply_Air_Flow_Sensor. It is defined as: The computed average flow of supply air over some interval

brick:Average_Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Average Zone Air Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor. It is defined as: The computed average temperature of air in a zone, over some period of time
brick:BACnet_Controller is a class in the schema. Its label is "BACnet Controller". It is a subclass of brick:Controller.

brick:Backflow_Preventer_Valve is a class in the schema. Its label is "Backflow Preventer Valve". It is a subclass of brick:Check_Valve. It is defined as: Valve designed to prevent the reverse flow of fluid, typically water, thereby protecting potable water supplies from contamination or pollution.

brick:Baseboard_Radiator is a class in the schema. Its label is "Baseboard Radiator". It is a subclass of brick:Radiator. It is defined as: Steam, hydronic, or electric heating device located at or near the floor.
brick:Basement is a class in the schema. Its label is "Basement". It is a subclass of brick:Floor. It is defined as: The floor of a building which is partly or entirely below ground level.

brick:Battery is a class in the schema. Its label is "Battery". It is a subclass of brick:Energy_Storage. It is defined as: A container that stores chemical energy that can be converted into electricity and used as a source of power

brick:Battery_Energy_Storage_System is a class in the schema. Its label is "Battery Energy Storage System". It is a subclass of brick:Energy_Storage_System. It is defined as: A collection of batteries that provides energy storage, along with their supporting equipment
brick:Battery_Room is a class in the schema. Its label is "Battery Room". It is a subclass of brick:Electrical_Room. It is defined as: A room used to hold batteries for backup power
brick:Battery_Voltage_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Battery Voltage Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Voltage_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the capacity of a battery

brick:Bench_Space is a class in the schema. Its label is "Bench Space". It is a subclass of brick:Outdoor_Area. It is defined as: For areas of play in a stadium, the area for partcipants and referees by the side of the field
brick:Blind is a class in the schema. Its label is "Blind". It is a subclass of brick:Shading_Equipment. It is defined as: A window covering.
brick:Blind_Group is a class in the schema. Its label is "Blind Group". It is a subclass of brick:Shading_System. It is defined as: A group of Blinds commonly attached to a single controller.

brick:Boiler is a class in the schema. Its label is "Boiler". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment, brick:Water_Heater. It is defined as: A closed, pressure vessel that uses fuel or electricity for heating water or other fluids to supply steam or hot water for heating, humidification, or other applications.
brick:Boiler_Command is a class in the schema. Its label is "Boiler Command". It is a subclass of brick:Command. It is defined as: A command to control a boiler

brick:Booster_Fan is a class in the schema. Its label is "Booster Fan". It is a subclass of brick:Fan. It is defined as: Fan activated to increase airflow beyond what is provided by the default configuration

brick:Booster_Pump is a class in the schema. Its label is "Booster Pump". It is a subclass of brick:Pump. It is defined as: Used to increase the pressure and flow of a fluid, typically water, in a system to ensure adequate supply where needed.
brick:Box_Mode_Command is a class in the schema. Its label is "Box Mode Command". It is a subclass of brick:Mode_Command.

brick:Branch_Selector is a class in the schema. Its label is "Branch Selector". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment. It is defined as: A device in VRF systems that regulates the flow of refrigerant to different indoor units or branches, ensuring optimal distribution of heating or cooling according to the specific requirements of each zone or area in the building.
brick:Break_Room is a class in the schema. Its label is "Break Room". It is a subclass of brick:Room. It is defined as: A space for people to relax while not working
brick:Breaker_Panel is a class in the schema. Its label is "Breaker Panel". It is a subclass of brick:Electrical_Equipment. It is defined as: Breaker Panel distributes power into various end-uses.
brick:Breakroom is a class in the schema. Its label is "Breakroom". It is a subclass of brick:Room. It is defined as: A space for people to relax while not working
brick:Broadcast_Room is a class in the schema. Its label is "Broadcast Room". It is a subclass of brick:Media_Room. It is defined as: A space to organize and manage a broadcast. Separate from studio

brick:Building is a class in the schema. Its label is "Building". It is a subclass of brick:Location. It is defined as: An independent unit of the built environment with a characteristic spatial structure, intended to serve at least one function or user activity [ISO 12006-2:2013]

brick:Building_Air_Humidity_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Building Air Humidity Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Humidity_Setpoint. It is defined as: Setpoint for humidity in a building

brick:Building_Air_Static_Pressure_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Building Air Static Pressure Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Static_Pressure_Sensor. It is defined as: The static pressure of air within a building

brick:Building_Air_Static_Pressure_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Building Air Static Pressure Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Pressure_Setpoint, brick:Static_Pressure_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets static pressure of the entire building

brick:Building_Chilled_Water_Meter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Building Chilled Water Meter". It is a subclass of brick:Building_Meter, brick:Chilled_Water_Meter. It is defined as: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of chilled water of a whole building
brick:Building_Disconnect_Switch is a class in the schema. Its label is "Building Disconnect Switch". It is a subclass of brick:Disconnect_Switch.

brick:Building_Electrical_Meter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Building Electrical Meter". It is a subclass of brick:Building_Meter, brick:Electrical_Meter. It is defined as: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of electricity of a whole building

brick:Building_Gas_Meter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Building Gas Meter". It is a subclass of brick:Building_Meter, brick:Gas_Meter. It is defined as: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of gas of a whole building

brick:Building_Hot_Water_Meter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Building Hot Water Meter". It is a subclass of brick:Building_Meter, brick:Hot_Water_Meter. It is defined as: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of hot water of a whole building

brick:Building_Meter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Building Meter". It is a subclass of brick:Meter. It is defined as: A meter that measures usage or consumption of some media for a whole building

brick:Building_Water_Meter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Building Water Meter". It is a subclass of brick:Building_Meter, brick:Water_Meter. It is defined as: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of water of a whole building

brick:Bus_Riser is a class in the schema. Its label is "Bus Riser". It is a subclass of brick:Electrical_Equipment. It is defined as: Bus Risers are commonly fed from a switchgear and rise up through a series of floors to the main power distribution source for each floor.
brick:Bypass_Air_Flow_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Bypass Air Flow Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Flow_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the rate of flow of bypass air

brick:Bypass_Air_Humidity_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Bypass Air Humidity Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Humidity_Setpoint. It is defined as: Humidity setpoint for bypass air
brick:Bypass_Command is a class in the schema. Its label is "Bypass Command". It is a subclass of brick:Command.

brick:Bypass_Damper is a class in the schema. Its label is "Bypass Damper". It is a subclass of brick:Damper. It is defined as: A bypass damper is a type of damper that is employed in forced-air bypass applications to reduce the buildup of static pressure, usually when certain zone dampers are closed.
brick:Bypass_Valve is a class in the schema. Its label is "Bypass Valve". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment, brick:Valve. It is defined as: A type of valve installed in a bypass pipeline

brick:Bypass_Water_Flow_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Bypass Water Flow Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Flow_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the rate of flow of bypass water

brick:Bypass_Water_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Bypass Water Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Flow_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the target flow rate of bypass water
brick:CAV is a class in the schema. Its label is "CAV". It is a subclass of brick:Terminal_Unit.

brick:CO2_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "CO2 Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm that indicates the off-normal conditions associated with the presence of carbon dioxide.

brick:CO2_Alarm_Sensitivity_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "CO2 Alarm Sensitivity Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Alarm_Sensitivity_Parameter. It is defined as: A parameter indicates the sensitivity to activate a CO2 alarm.

brick:CO2_Differential_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "CO2 Differential Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:CO2_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the difference between CO2 levels of inside and outside air
brick:CO2_Level_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "CO2 Level Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:CO2_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the concentration of CO2 in air
brick:CO2_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "CO2 Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Quality_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures properties of CO2 in air
brick:CO2_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "CO2 Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets some property of CO2
brick:CO_Differential_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "CO Differential Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:CO_Sensor.
brick:CO_Level_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "CO Level Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:CO_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the concentration of CO
brick:CO_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "CO Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Quality_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures properties of CO
brick:CRAC is a class in the schema. Its label is "CRAC". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment.

brick:CRAH is a class in the schema. Its label is "CRAH". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment. It is defined as: a computer room air handler (CRAH) uses fans, cooling coils and a water-chiller system to remove heat.
brick:Cafeteria is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cafeteria". It is a subclass of brick:Common_Space. It is defined as: A space to serve food and beverages
brick:Camera is a class in the schema. Its label is "Camera". It is a subclass of brick:Equipment.
brick:Capacity_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Capacity Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor.

brick:Capillary_Tube_Metering_Device is a class in the schema. Its label is "Capillary Tube Metering Device". It is a subclass of brick:Refrigerant_Metering_Device. It is defined as: A fixed orifice device in refrigeration systems that controls refrigerant flow based on its diameter and length, without moving parts

brick:Cassette_Fan_Coil_Unit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cassette Fan Coil Unit". It is a subclass of brick:Fan_Coil_Unit. It is defined as: A type of fan coil unit installed within the ceiling void, typically using a cassette for air delivery
brick:Ceiling_Fan is a class in the schema. Its label is "Ceiling Fan". It is a subclass of brick:Fan. It is defined as: A fan installed on the ceiling of a room for the purpose of air circulation

brick:Centrifugal_Chiller is a class in the schema. Its label is "Centrifugal Chiller". It is a subclass of brick:Chiller. It is defined as: A chiller that uses the vapor compression cycle to chill water. It throws off the heat collected from the chilled water plus the heat from the compressor to a water loop
brick:Change_Filter_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Change Filter Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm that indicates that a filter must be changed

brick:Check_Valve is a class in the schema. Its label is "Check Valve". It is a subclass of brick:Valve. It is defined as: Valve that allows fluid to flow in only one direction, preventing reverse flow.

brick:Chilled_Beam is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Beam". It is a subclass of brick:Terminal_Unit. It is defined as: A device with an integrated coil that performs sensible heating of a space via circulation of room air. Chilled Beams are not designed to perform latent cooling; see Induction Units. Despite their name, Chilled Beams may perform heating or cooling of a space depending on their configuration.

brick:Chilled_Water_Booster_Pump is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Booster Pump". It is a subclass of brick:Booster_Pump, brick:Chilled_Water_Pump. It is defined as: Used to increase the pressure and flow of chilled water in a system to ensure adequate supply where needed.

brick:Chilled_Water_Circulator_Pump is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Circulator Pump". It is a subclass of brick:Chilled_Water_Pump, brick:Circulator_Pump. It is defined as: Used to move chilled water in a closed circuit, ensuring continuous flow.

brick:Chilled_Water_Coil is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Coil". It is a subclass of brick:Cooling_Coil. It is defined as: A cooling element made of pipe or tube that removes heat from equipment, machines or airflows that is filled with chilled water.

brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Pressure_Deadband_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Differential Pressure Deadband Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Differential_Pressure_Deadband_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the size of a deadband of differential pressure of chilled water

brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Pressure_Integral_Time_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Differential Pressure Integral Time Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Differential_Pressure_Integral_Time_Parameter.

brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Pressure_Load_Shed_Reset_Status is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Differential Pressure Load Shed Reset Status". It is a subclass of brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Pressure_Load_Shed_Status.

brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Pressure_Load_Shed_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Differential Pressure Load Shed Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Pressure_Setpoint, brick:Load_Shed_Differential_Pressure_Setpoint.

brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Pressure_Load_Shed_Status is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Differential Pressure Load Shed Status". It is a subclass of brick:Differential_Pressure_Load_Shed_Status.

brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Pressure_Proportional_Band_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Differential Pressure Proportional Band Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Differential_Pressure_Proportional_Band.

brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Pressure_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Differential Pressure Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Differential_Pressure_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the difference in water pressure on either side of a chilled water valve

brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Pressure_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Differential Pressure Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Differential_Pressure_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the target water differential pressure between an upstream and downstream point in a water pipe or conduit used to carry chilled water

brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Pressure_Step_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Differential Pressure Step Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Differential_Pressure_Step_Parameter.

brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Differential Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Chilled_Water_Temperature_Sensor, brick:Water_Differential_Temperature_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the difference in temperature between the entering water to the chiller or other water cooling device and leaving water from the same chiller or other water cooling device

brick:Chilled_Water_Discharge_Flow_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Discharge Flow Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Chilled_Water_Flow_Sensor, brick:Discharge_Water_Flow_Sensor.

brick:Chilled_Water_Discharge_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Discharge Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Chilled_Water_Flow_Setpoint, brick:Discharge_Water_Flow_Setpoint.

brick:Chilled_Water_Discharge_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Discharge Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Chilled_Water_Temperature_Sensor, brick:Discharge_Water_Temperature_Sensor.

brick:Chilled_Water_Flow_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Flow Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Flow_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the rate of flow in a chilled water circuit

brick:Chilled_Water_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Flow_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the target flow rate of chilled water

brick:Chilled_Water_Gauge_Pressure_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Gauge Pressure Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Gauge_Pressure_Sensor. It is defined as: Sensor measuring the gauge pressure (zero-referenced against ambient air pressure) of chilled water

brick:Chilled_Water_Loop is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Loop". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Loop. It is defined as: A collection of equipment that transport and regulate chilled water among each other

brick:Chilled_Water_Meter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Meter". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Meter. It is defined as: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of chilled water

brick:Chilled_Water_Pump is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Pump". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Pump. It is defined as: A pump that performs work on chilled water; typically part of a chilled water system
brick:Chilled_Water_Return_Flow_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Return Flow Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Chilled_Water_Flow_Sensor, brick:Return_Water_Flow_Sensor.

brick:Chilled_Water_Return_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Return Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Chilled_Water_Temperature_Sensor, brick:Return_Water_Temperature_Sensor.

brick:Chilled_Water_Static_Pressure_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Static Pressure Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Static_Pressure_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets static pressure of chilled water

brick:Chilled_Water_Storage_Tank is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Storage Tank". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Storage_Tank. It is defined as: A tank specifically designed to store chilled water in HVAC systems.
brick:Chilled_Water_Supply_Flow_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Supply Flow Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Chilled_Water_Flow_Sensor, brick:Supply_Water_Flow_Sensor.

brick:Chilled_Water_Supply_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Supply Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Chilled_Water_Flow_Setpoint, brick:Supply_Water_Flow_Setpoint.

brick:Chilled_Water_Supply_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Supply Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Chilled_Water_Temperature_Sensor, brick:Supply_Water_Temperature_Sensor.

brick:Chilled_Water_System is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water System". It is a subclass of brick:Water_System. It is defined as: The equipment, devices and conduits that handle the production and distribution of chilled water in a building

brick:Chilled_Water_System_Enable_Command is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water System Enable Command". It is a subclass of brick:System_Enable_Command. It is defined as: Enables operation of the chilled water system

brick:Chilled_Water_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Temperature_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the temperature of chilled water

brick:Chilled_Water_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Temperature_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the temperature of chilled water

brick:Chilled_Water_Thermal_Energy_Storage_Tank is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Thermal Energy Storage Tank". It is a subclass of brick:Thermal_Energy_Storage_Tank. It is defined as: A Thermal Energy Storage (TES) tank is a specialized container for storing thermal energy, enabling more efficient cooling by balancing supply and demand. It helps reduce operational costs and minimizes the need for larger equipment.

brick:Chilled_Water_Thermal_Expansion_Tank is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Thermal Expansion Tank". It is a subclass of brick:Thermal_Expansion_Tank. It is defined as: A thermal expansion tank designed specifically for chilled water systems.

brick:Chilled_Water_Valve is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chilled Water Valve". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Valve, brick:Water_Valve. It is defined as: A valve that modulates the flow of chilled water

brick:Chiller is a class in the schema. Its label is "Chiller". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment. It is defined as: Refrigerating machine used to transfer heat between fluids. Chillers are either direct expansion with a compressor or absorption type.

brick:Circuit_Breaker is a class in the schema. Its label is "Circuit Breaker". It is a subclass of brick:Switchgear. It is defined as: A circuit breaker is a safety device to prevent damage to devices in a circuit, such as electric motors, and wiring when the current flowing through the electrical circuit supersedes its design limits. It does this by removing the current from a circuit when an unsafe condition arises. Unlike a switch, a circuit breaker automatically does this and shuts off the power immediately.

brick:Circulator_Pump is a class in the schema. Its label is "Circulator Pump". It is a subclass of brick:Pump. It is defined as: Used to move hot or cold water in a closed circuit, ensuring continuous fluid flow.
brick:Class is a class in the schema. Its label is "Class". It is a subclass of brick:Entity.

brick:Close_Limit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Close Limit". It is a subclass of brick:Limit. It is defined as: A parameter that places a lower or upper bound on the range of permitted values of a Close_Setpoint.

brick:Coil is a class in the schema. Its label is "Coil". It is a subclass of brick:Heat_Exchanger. It is defined as: Cooling or heating element made of pipe or tube that may or may not be finned and formed into helical or serpentine shape (ASHRAE Dictionary)

brick:Cold_Box is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cold Box". It is a subclass of brick:Laboratory. It is defined as: in a gas separation unit, the insulated section that contains the low-temperature heat exchangers and distillation columns.

brick:Cold_Deck is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cold Deck". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment. It is defined as: Part of a dual duct air handling unit that supplies cooling to a building

brick:Cold_Water_Storage_Tank is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cold Water Storage Tank". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Storage_Tank. It is defined as: A tank used to store cold water, usually in a building's water supply system.

brick:Coldest_Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Coldest Zone Air Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor. It is defined as: The zone temperature that is coldest; drives the supply temperature of hot air. A computed value rather than a physical sensor. Also referred to as a 'Lowest Zone Air Temperature Sensor'
brick:Collection is a class in the schema. Its label is "Collection". It is a subclass of brick:Class, brick:Entity, rec:Collection.

brick:Collection_Basin_Water_Heater is a class in the schema. Its label is "Collection Basin Water Heater". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Heater. It is defined as: Basin heaters prevent cold water basin freeze-up, e.g. in cooling towers, closed circuit fluid coolers, or evaporative condensers

brick:Collection_Basin_Water_Level_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Collection Basin Water Level Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Level_Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm that indicates a high or low level of water in the collection basin, e.g. within a Cooling_Tower

brick:Collection_Basin_Water_Level_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Collection Basin Water Level Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Level_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the level of the water in the collection basin, e.g. within a Cooling_Tower

brick:Collection_Basin_Water_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Collection Basin Water Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Temperature_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the temperature of the water in the collection basin, e.g. within a Cooling_Tower

brick:Command is a class in the schema. Its label is "Command". It is a subclass of brick:Point. It is defined as: A Command is an output point that directly determines the behavior of equipment and/or affects relevant operational points.
brick:Common_Space is a class in the schema. Its label is "Common Space". It is a subclass of brick:Space. It is defined as: A class of spaces that are used by multiple people at the same time

brick:Communication_Loss_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Communication Loss Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm that indicates a loss of communication e.g. with a device or controller

brick:Compressor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Compressor". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment. It is defined as: (1) device for mechanically increasing the pressure of a gas. (2) often described as being either open, hermetic, or semihermetic to describe how the compressor and motor drive is situated in relation to the gas or vapor being compressed. Types include centrifugal, axial flow, reciprocating, rotary screw, rotary vane, scroll, or diaphragm. 1. device for mechanically increasing the pressure of a gas. 2. specific machine, with or without accessories, for compressing refrigerant vapor.

brick:Computer_Room_Air_Conditioning is a class in the schema. Its label is "Computer Room Air Conditioning". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment. It is defined as: A device that monitors and maintains the temperature, air distribution and humidity in a network room or data center.

brick:Computer_Room_Air_Handler is a class in the schema. Its label is "Computer Room Air Handler". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment. It is defined as: a computer room air handler (CRAH) uses fans, cooling coils and a water-chiller system to remove heat.

brick:Concession is a class in the schema. Its label is "Concession". It is a subclass of brick:Food_Service_Room. It is defined as: A space to sell food and beverages. Usually embedded in a larger space and does not include a space where people consume their purchases

brick:Condensate_Leak_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condensate Leak Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Leak_Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm that indicates a leak of condensate from a cooling system

brick:Condenser_Heat_Exchanger is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condenser Heat Exchanger". It is a subclass of brick:Heat_Exchanger. It is defined as: A heat exchanger in which the primary heat transfer vapor changes its state to a liquid phase.

brick:Condenser_Water_Booster_Pump is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condenser Water Booster Pump". It is a subclass of brick:Booster_Pump, brick:Condenser_Water_Pump. It is defined as: Used to increase the pressure and flow of condenser water in a system to ensure adequate supply where needed.

brick:Condenser_Water_Bypass_Valve is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condenser Water Bypass Valve". It is a subclass of brick:Bypass_Valve. It is defined as: A valve installed in a bypass line of a condenser water loop

brick:Condenser_Water_Circulator_Pump is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condenser Water Circulator Pump". It is a subclass of brick:Circulator_Pump, brick:Condenser_Water_Pump. It is defined as: Used to move chilled water in a closed circuit, ensuring continuous flow.

brick:Condenser_Water_Flow_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condenser Water Flow Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Flow_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the flow of the condenser water
brick:Condenser_Water_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condenser Water Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Flow_Setpoint.

brick:Condenser_Water_Isolation_Valve is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condenser Water Isolation Valve". It is a subclass of brick:Isolation_Valve. It is defined as: An isolation valve installed in the condenser water loop

brick:Condenser_Water_Loop is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condenser Water Loop". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Loop. It is defined as: A collection of equipment that transport and regulate condenser water among each other

brick:Condenser_Water_Pump is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condenser Water Pump". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Pump. It is defined as: A pump that is part of a condenser system; the pump circulates condenser water from the chiller back to the cooling tower

brick:Condenser_Water_System is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condenser Water System". It is a subclass of brick:Water_System. It is defined as: A heat rejection system consisting of (typically) cooling towers, condenser water pumps, chillers and the piping connecting the components

brick:Condenser_Water_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condenser Water Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Temperature_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the temperature of condenser water

brick:Condenser_Water_Valve is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condenser Water Valve". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Valve, brick:Water_Valve. It is defined as: A valve that modulates the flow of condenser water

brick:Condensing_Natural_Gas_Boiler is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condensing Natural Gas Boiler". It is a subclass of brick:Natural_Gas_Boiler. It is defined as: A closed, pressure vessel that uses natural gas and heat exchanger that capture and reuse any latent heat for heating water or other fluids to supply steam or hot water for heating, humidification, or other applications.

brick:Condensing_Unit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Condensing Unit". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment. It is defined as: An outdoor HVAC unit that typically condenses refrigerant from gas to liquid, integral to the refrigeration cycle. It comprises a condenser coil, compressor, fan, and potentially a reversing valve in heat pump applications.
brick:Conductivity_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Conductivity Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor. It is defined as: Measures electrical conductance
brick:Conference_Room is a class in the schema. Its label is "Conference Room". It is a subclass of brick:Room. It is defined as: A space dedicated in which to hold a meetings

brick:Constant_Air_Volume_Box is a class in the schema. Its label is "Constant Air Volume Box". It is a subclass of brick:Terminal_Unit. It is defined as: A terminal unit for which supply air flow rate is constant and the supply air temperature is varied to meet thermal load

brick:Contact_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Contact Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor. It is defined as: Senses or detects contact, such as for determining if a door is closed.
brick:Control_Room is a class in the schema. Its label is "Control Room". It is a subclass of brick:Room. It is defined as: A space from which operations are managed
brick:Controller is a class in the schema. Its label is "Controller". It is a subclass of brick:ICT_Equipment.

brick:Cooling_Coil is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Coil". It is a subclass of brick:Coil. It is defined as: A cooling element made of pipe or tube that removes heat from equipment, machines or airflows. Typically filled with either refrigerant or cold water.

brick:Cooling_Command is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Command". It is a subclass of brick:Command. It is defined as: Controls the amount of cooling to be delivered (typically as a proportion of total cooling output)

brick:Cooling_Demand_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Demand Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Demand_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the amount of power consumed by a cooling process; typically found by multiplying the tonnage of a unit (e.g. RTU) by the efficiency rating in kW/ton
brick:Cooling_Demand_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Demand Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Demand_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the rate required for cooling

brick:Cooling_Discharge_Air_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Discharge Air Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets discharge air flow for cooling

brick:Cooling_Discharge_Air_Temperature_Deadband_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Discharge Air Temperature Deadband Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint, brick:Discharge_Air_Temperature_Cooling_Setpoint, brick:Supply_Air_Temperature_Deadband_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the size of a deadband of temperature of cooling discharge air

brick:Cooling_Discharge_Air_Temperature_Integral_Time_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Discharge Air Temperature Integral Time Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Temperature_Integral_Time_Parameter.

brick:Cooling_Discharge_Air_Temperature_Proportional_Band_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Discharge Air Temperature Proportional Band Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Supply_Air_Temperature_Proportional_Band_Parameter.

brick:Cooling_Enable_Command is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Enable Command". It is a subclass of brick:Enable_Command. It is defined as: Command that enables cooling functionality in equipment but certain condition(s) must be met first before actively cooling. For the actively cooling control, see Cooling_Command.

brick:Cooling_Mode_Status is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Mode Status". It is a subclass of brick:Mode_Status. It is defined as: Indicates whether a system, device or control loop is in a cooling mode
brick:Cooling_Only_Air_Source_Condensing_Unit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Only Air Source Condensing Unit". It is a subclass of brick:Cooling_Only_Condensing_Unit.
brick:Cooling_Only_Condensing_Unit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Only Condensing Unit". It is a subclass of brick:Condensing_Unit.
brick:Cooling_Only_Ground_Source_Condensing_Unit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Only Ground Source Condensing Unit". It is a subclass of brick:Cooling_Only_Condensing_Unit.
brick:Cooling_Only_Water_Source_Condensing_Unit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Only Water Source Condensing Unit". It is a subclass of brick:Cooling_Only_Condensing_Unit.
brick:Cooling_Start_Stop_Status is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Start Stop Status". It is a subclass of brick:Start_Stop_Status.

brick:Cooling_Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Supply Air Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets supply air flow rate for cooling

brick:Cooling_Supply_Air_Temperature_Deadband_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Supply Air Temperature Deadband Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint, brick:Discharge_Air_Temperature_Cooling_Setpoint, brick:Supply_Air_Temperature_Deadband_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the size of a deadband of temperature of supply air for cooling

brick:Cooling_Supply_Air_Temperature_Integral_Time_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Supply Air Temperature Integral Time Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Temperature_Integral_Time_Parameter.

brick:Cooling_Supply_Air_Temperature_Proportional_Band_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Supply Air Temperature Proportional Band Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Supply_Air_Temperature_Proportional_Band_Parameter.

brick:Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Temperature_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets temperature for cooling

brick:Cooling_Tower is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Tower". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment. It is defined as: A cooling tower is a heat rejection device that rejects waste heat to the atmosphere through the cooling of a water stream to a lower temperature. Cooling towers may either use the evaporation of water to remove process heat and cool the working fluid to near the wet-bulb air temperature or, in the case of closed circuit dry cooling towers, rely solely on air to cool the working fluid to near the dry-bulb air temperature.

brick:Cooling_Tower_Fan is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Tower Fan". It is a subclass of brick:Fan. It is defined as: A fan that pulls air through a cooling tower and across the louvers where the water falls to aid in heat exchange by the process of evaporation

brick:Cooling_Valve is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Valve". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment, brick:Valve. It is defined as: A valve that controls air temperature by modulating the amount of cold water flowing through a cooling coil

brick:Cooling_Zone_Air_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cooling Zone Air Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Temperature_Setpoint. It is defined as: The cooling setpoint for a specific zone in a building.
brick:Copy_Room is a class in the schema. Its label is "Copy Room". It is a subclass of brick:Room. It is defined as: A room set aside for common office equipment, including printers and copiers

brick:Core_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Core Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Embedded_Temperature_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the internal temperature of the radiant layer at the heat source or sink level of the radiant heating and cooling HVAC system.

brick:Core_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Core Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Embedded_Temperature_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets temperature for the core, i.e. the temperature at the heat source or sink level, of the radiant panel.

brick:Cubicle is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cubicle". It is a subclass of brick:Office. It is defined as: A smaller space set aside for an individual, but not with a door and without full-height walls

brick:Current_Imbalance_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Current Imbalance Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Imbalance_Sensor. It is defined as: A sensor which measures the current difference (imbalance) between phases of an electrical system

brick:Current_Limit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Current Limit". It is a subclass of brick:Limit. It is defined as: A parameter that places a lower or upper bound on the range of permitted values of a Current_Setpoint.

brick:Current_Output_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Current Output Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Current_Sensor. It is defined as: Senses the amperes of electrical current produced as output by a device
brick:Current_Ratio_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Current Ratio Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the ratio of currents in a transformer
brick:Current_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Current Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor. It is defined as: Senses the amperes of electrical current passing through the sensor
brick:Curtailment_Override_Command is a class in the schema. Its label is "Curtailment Override Command". It is a subclass of brick:Override_Command.
brick:Cycle_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Cycle Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm that indicates off-normal conditions associated with HVAC cycles
