brick:Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets temperature
brick:Temperature_Step_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Temperature Step Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Step_Parameter, brick:Temperature_Parameter.

brick:Temperature_Tolerance_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Temperature Tolerance Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Temperature_Parameter, brick:Tolerance_Parameter. It is defined as: A parameter determining the difference between upper and lower limits of temperature.

brick:Temporary_Occupancy_Status is a class in the schema. Its label is "Temporary Occupancy Status". It is a subclass of brick:Occupancy_Status. It is defined as: For systems that differentiate between scheduled occupied/unoccupied mode, this indicates if a space is temporarily occupied when it would otherwise be unoccupied

brick:Terminal_Unit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Terminal Unit". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment. It is defined as: A device that regulates the volumetric flow rate and/or the temperature of the controlled medium.

brick:Thermal_Energy_Storage_Tank is a class in the schema. Its label is "Thermal Energy Storage Tank". It is a subclass of brick:Storage_Tank. It is defined as: A Thermal Energy Storage (TES) tank is a specialized container for storing thermal energy, enabling more efficient heating and cooling by balancing supply and demand. It helps reduce operational costs and minimizes the need for larger equipment.

brick:Thermal_Energy_Usage_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Thermal Energy Usage Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Energy_Usage_Sensor. It is defined as: A sensor that records the quantity of thermal energy consumed in a given period

brick:Thermal_Expansion_Tank is a class in the schema. Its label is "Thermal Expansion Tank". It is a subclass of brick:Tank. It is defined as: A tank designed to accommodate the expansion and contraction of a fluid, typically water, in a closed heating or cooling system.

brick:Thermal_Expansion_Valve is a class in the schema. Its label is "Thermal Expansion Valve". It is a subclass of brick:Refrigerant_Metering_Device. It is defined as: An type of metering device that automatically adjusts refrigerant flow based on temperature changes, using a sensing bulb
brick:Thermal_Power_Meter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Thermal Power Meter". It is a subclass of brick:Meter. It is defined as: A standalone thermal power meter
brick:Thermal_Power_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Thermal Power Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Power_Sensor.

brick:Thermally_Activated_Building_System_Panel is a class in the schema. Its label is "Thermally Activated Building System Panel". It is a subclass of brick:Radiant_Panel. It is defined as: Radiant panel heating and cooling system where the energy heat source or sink is embedded in the building structure such as in slabs and walls.

brick:Thermostat is a class in the schema. Its label is "Thermostat". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment, brick:Sensor_Equipment. It is defined as: An automatic control device used to maintain temperature at a fixed or adjustable setpoint.
brick:Thermostat_Equipment is a class in the schema. Its label is "Thermostat Equipment". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor_Equipment.
brick:Thermostat_Status is a class in the schema. Its label is "Thermostat Status". It is a subclass of brick:Status. It is defined as: Status of a thermostat

brick:Thermostatic_Mixing_Valve is a class in the schema. Its label is "Thermostatic Mixing Valve". It is a subclass of brick:Mixing_Valve. It is defined as: A valve that blends hot water with cold water to ensure constant, safe shower and bath outlet temperatures, preventing scalding.

brick:Ticketing_Booth is a class in the schema. Its label is "Ticketing Booth". It is a subclass of brick:Space. It is defined as: A room or space used to sell or distribute tickets to events at a venue
brick:Time_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Time Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:PID_Parameter.
brick:Time_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Time Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Setpoint.
brick:Tint_Command is a class in the schema. Its label is "Tint Command". It is a subclass of brick:Command. It is defined as: The target level of window tint.
brick:Tint_Status is a class in the schema. Its label is "Tint Status". It is a subclass of brick:Status. It is defined as: The current level of window tint, errors, or transient states.

brick:Tolerance_Parameter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Tolerance Parameter". It is a subclass of brick:Parameter. It is defined as: difference between upper and lower limits of size for a given nominal dimension or value.

brick:Torque_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Torque Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor. It is defined as: Measures torque, the tendency of a force to rotate an object about some axis

brick:Touchpanel is a class in the schema. Its label is "Touchpanel". It is a subclass of brick:Interface. It is defined as: A switch used to operate all or part of a lighting installation that uses a touch-based mechanism (typically resistive or capacitive) rather than a mechanical actuator
brick:Transfer_Fan is a class in the schema. Its label is "Transfer Fan". It is a subclass of brick:Fan. It is defined as: A fan that transfers air from a space to another space.

brick:Transfer_Switch is a class in the schema. Its label is "Transfer Switch". It is a subclass of brick:Switchgear. It is defined as: An electrical switch that switches a load between two (or more) sources.

brick:Transformer is a class in the schema. Its label is "Transformer". It is a subclass of brick:Electrical_Equipment. It is defined as: A Transformer is usually fed by a high-voltage source and then steps down the voltage to a lower-voltage feed for low-voltage application (such as lights). Transformers also can step up voltage, but this generally does not apply to in building distribution.

brick:Transformer_Room is a class in the schema. Its label is "Transformer Room". It is a subclass of brick:Electrical_Room. It is defined as: An electrical room where electricity enters and is transformed to different voltages and currents by the equipment contained in the room
brick:Tunnel is a class in the schema. Its label is "Tunnel". It is a subclass of brick:Space. It is defined as: An enclosed space that connects buildings. Often underground

brick:Underfloor_Air_Plenum is a class in the schema. Its label is "Underfloor Air Plenum". It is a subclass of brick:Supply_Air_Plenum. It is defined as: An open space between a structural concrete slab and the underside of a raised access floor system that connects to an air handling unit to receive conditioned and/or ventilating air before delivery to the room(s)

brick:Underfloor_Air_Plenum_Static_Pressure_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Underfloor Air Plenum Static Pressure Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Static_Pressure_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the outward push of air against the plenum surfaces and used to measure the resistance when air moves through the plenum

brick:Underfloor_Air_Plenum_Static_Pressure_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Underfloor Air Plenum Static Pressure Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Static_Pressure_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the underfloor air plenum static pressure

brick:Underfloor_Air_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Underfloor Air Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Temperature_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the temperature of underfloor air

brick:Unit_Failure_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unit Failure Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Failure_Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm that indicates the failure of an equipment or device
brick:Unoccupied_Air_Temperature_Cooling_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Air Temperature Cooling Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Unoccupied_Air_Temperature_Setpoint.
brick:Unoccupied_Air_Temperature_Heating_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Air Temperature Heating Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Unoccupied_Air_Temperature_Setpoint.

brick:Unoccupied_Air_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Air Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Air_Temperature_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets temperature of air when unoccupied

brick:Unoccupied_Cooling_Discharge_Air_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Cooling Discharge Air Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Cooling_Discharge_Air_Flow_Setpoint, brick:Cooling_Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint, brick:Unoccupied_Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets discharge air flow for cooling when unoccupied

brick:Unoccupied_Cooling_Mode_Status is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Cooling Mode Status". It is a subclass of brick:Cooling_Mode_Status, brick:Unoccupied_Mode_Status. It is defined as: Indicates whether a system, device or control loop is in an unoccupied cooling mode

brick:Unoccupied_Cooling_Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Cooling Supply Air Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Cooling_Discharge_Air_Flow_Setpoint, brick:Cooling_Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint, brick:Unoccupied_Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint.

brick:Unoccupied_Cooling_Temperature_Deadband_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Cooling Temperature Deadband Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint, brick:Temperature_Deadband_Setpoint.
brick:Unoccupied_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Cooling Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint.

brick:Unoccupied_Cooling_Zone_Air_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Cooling Zone Air Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Cooling_Zone_Air_Temperature_Setpoint, brick:Unoccupied_Air_Temperature_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets temperature of air when unoccupied for cooling within a specific zone
brick:Unoccupied_Discharge_Air_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Discharge Air Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint.

brick:Unoccupied_Discharge_Air_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Discharge Air Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Supply_Air_Temperature_Setpoint, brick:Unoccupied_Air_Temperature_Setpoint.

brick:Unoccupied_Heating_Discharge_Air_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Heating Discharge Air Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Heating_Discharge_Air_Flow_Setpoint, brick:Heating_Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint, brick:Unoccupied_Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint.

brick:Unoccupied_Heating_Mode_Status is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Heating Mode Status". It is a subclass of brick:Heating_Mode_Status, brick:Unoccupied_Mode_Status. It is defined as: Indicates whether a system, device or control loop is in an unoccupied heating mode

brick:Unoccupied_Heating_Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Heating Supply Air Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Heating_Discharge_Air_Flow_Setpoint, brick:Heating_Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint, brick:Unoccupied_Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint.

brick:Unoccupied_Heating_Temperature_Deadband_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Heating Temperature Deadband Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Heating_Temperature_Setpoint, brick:Temperature_Deadband_Setpoint.
brick:Unoccupied_Heating_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Heating Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Heating_Temperature_Setpoint.

brick:Unoccupied_Heating_Zone_Air_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Heating Zone Air Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Heating_Zone_Air_Temperature_Setpoint, brick:Unoccupied_Air_Temperature_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets temperature of air when unoccupied for heating within a specific zone

brick:Unoccupied_Humidity_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Humidity Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Humidity_Setpoint. It is defined as: Target humidity level when the location is unoccupied.
brick:Unoccupied_Load_Shed_Command is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Load Shed Command". It is a subclass of brick:Load_Shed_Command.
brick:Unoccupied_Mode_Status is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Mode Status". It is a subclass of brick:Mode_Status.

brick:Unoccupied_Return_Air_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Return Air Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Return_Air_Temperature_Setpoint, brick:Unoccupied_Air_Temperature_Setpoint.

brick:Unoccupied_Room_Air_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Room Air Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Room_Air_Temperature_Setpoint, brick:Unoccupied_Air_Temperature_Setpoint.
brick:Unoccupied_Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Supply Air Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Supply_Air_Flow_Setpoint.

brick:Unoccupied_Supply_Air_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Supply Air Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Supply_Air_Temperature_Setpoint, brick:Unoccupied_Air_Temperature_Setpoint.

brick:Unoccupied_Target_Zone_Air_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Target Zone Air Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Target_Zone_Air_Temperature_Setpoint, brick:Unoccupied_Air_Temperature_Setpoint. It is defined as: Target Setpoint (also known as Common Setpoint) is a reference point representing the desired unoccupied air temperature in a specific zone of a building. This setpoint acts as a baseline from which deadband setpoints are established by adding or subtracting a deadband width.
brick:Unoccupied_Zone_Air_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Unoccupied Zone Air Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Setpoint.

brick:Usage_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Usage Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the amount of some substance that is consumed or used, over some period of time
brick:VAV is a class in the schema. Its label is "VAV". It is a subclass of brick:Terminal_Unit. It is defined as: See Variable_Air_Volume_Box

brick:VFD is a class in the schema. Its label is "VFD". It is a subclass of brick:Motor. It is defined as: Electronic device that varies its output frequency to vary the rotating speed of a motor, given a fixed input frequency. Used with fans or pumps to vary the flow in the system as a function of a maintained pressure.
brick:VFD_Enable_Command is a class in the schema. Its label is "VFD Enable Command". It is a subclass of brick:Enable_Command. It is defined as: Enables operation of a variable frequency drive
brick:VRF_System is a class in the schema. Its label is "VRF System". It is a subclass of brick:Heating_Ventilation_Air_Conditioning_System.

brick:Valve is a class in the schema. Its label is "Valve". It is a subclass of brick:Equipment. It is defined as: A device that regulates, directs or controls the flow of a fluid by opening, closing or partially obstructing various passageways

brick:Valve_Command is a class in the schema. Its label is "Valve Command". It is a subclass of brick:Command. It is defined as: Controls or reports the openness of a valve (typically as a proportion of its full range of motion)

brick:Valve_Position_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Valve Position Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm that indicates that the valve position is not in a normal state.

brick:Valve_Position_Command is a class in the schema. Its label is "Valve Position Command". It is a subclass of brick:Position_Command, brick:Valve_Command. It is defined as: Controls the position (the degree of openness) of a valve

brick:Valve_Position_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Valve Position Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Position_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the current position of a valve in terms of the percent of fully open
brick:Valve_Status is a class in the schema. Its label is "Valve Status". It is a subclass of brick:Status. It is defined as: The current status of the valve.

brick:Variable_Air_Volume_Box is a class in the schema. Its label is "Variable Air Volume Box". It is a subclass of brick:Terminal_Unit. It is defined as: A device that regulates the volume and temperature of air delivered to a zone by opening or closing a damper

brick:Variable_Air_Volume_Box_With_Reheat is a class in the schema. Its label is "Variable Air Volume Box With Reheat". It is a subclass of brick:Variable_Air_Volume_Box. It is defined as: A VAV box with a reheat coil mounted on the discharge end of the unit that can heat the air delivered to a zone

brick:Variable_Frequency_Drive is a class in the schema. Its label is "Variable Frequency Drive". It is a subclass of brick:Motor. It is defined as: Electronic device that varies its output frequency to vary the rotating speed of a motor, given a fixed input frequency. Used with fans or pumps to vary the flow in the system as a function of a maintained pressure.

brick:Velocity_Pressure_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Velocity Pressure Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Pressure_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the difference between total pressure and static pressure
brick:Velocity_Pressure_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Velocity Pressure Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Pressure_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets static veloicty pressure

brick:Vent_Operating_Mode_Status is a class in the schema. Its label is "Vent Operating Mode Status". It is a subclass of brick:Operating_Mode_Status. It is defined as: Indicates the current operating mode of a vent

brick:Ventilation_Air_Flow_Ratio_Limit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Ventilation Air Flow Ratio Limit". It is a subclass of brick:Limit. It is defined as: A parameter that places a lower or upper bound on the range of permitted values of a Ventilation_Air_Flow_Ratio_Setpoint.

brick:Ventilation_Air_System is a class in the schema. Its label is "Ventilation Air System". It is a subclass of brick:Air_System. It is defined as: The equipment, devices, and conduits that handle the introduction and distribution of ventilation air in the building
brick:Vertical_Space is a class in the schema. Its label is "Vertical Space". It is a subclass of brick:Space. It is defined as: A class of spaces used to connect multiple floors or levels..
brick:Vibration_Sensor_Equipment is a class in the schema. Its label is "Vibration Sensor Equipment". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor_Equipment.
brick:Video_Intercom is a class in the schema. Its label is "Video Intercom". It is a subclass of brick:Intercom_Equipment.
brick:Video_Surveillance_Equipment is a class in the schema. Its label is "Video Surveillance Equipment". It is a subclass of brick:Security_Equipment.

brick:Visitor_Lobby is a class in the schema. Its label is "Visitor Lobby". It is a subclass of brick:Lobby. It is defined as: A lobby for visitors to the building. Sometimes used to distinguish from an employee entrance looby
brick:Voltage_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Voltage Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm that indicates the voltage is not in a normal state.

brick:Voltage_Imbalance_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Voltage Imbalance Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Imbalance_Sensor. It is defined as: A sensor which measures the voltage difference (imbalance) between phases of an electrical system
brick:Voltage_Ratio_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Voltage Ratio Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the ratio of voltage in a transformer
brick:Voltage_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Voltage Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the voltage of an electrical device or object

brick:Wall_Air_Conditioner is a class in the schema. Its label is "Wall Air Conditioner". It is a subclass of brick:HVAC_Equipment. It is defined as: A wall air conditioner, also known as a window air conditioner when installed in a window frame, is a self-contained unit that cools a room by drawing in warm air, cooling it over a refrigerant coil, and recirculating it back into the space.

brick:Wall_Fan_Coil_Unit is a class in the schema. Its label is "Wall Fan Coil Unit". It is a subclass of brick:Fan_Coil_Unit. It is defined as: A wall-mounted fan coil unit used for individual room heating and cooling, often found in hotels, apartments, and offices
brick:Wardrobe is a class in the schema. Its label is "Wardrobe". It is a subclass of brick:Room. It is defined as: Storage for clothing, costumes, or uniforms

brick:Warm_Cool_Adjust_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Warm Cool Adjust Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Adjust_Sensor. It is defined as: User provided adjustment of zone temperature, typically in the range of +/- 5 degrees

brick:Warmest_Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Warmest Zone Air Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor. It is defined as: The zone temperature that is warmest; drives the supply temperature of cold air. A computed value rather than a physical sensor. Also referred to as a 'Highest Zone Air Temperature Sensor'

brick:Waste_Amount_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Waste Amount Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor. It is defined as: A metric used for measuring the quantity of waste generated in a building.

brick:Waste_Meter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Waste Meter". It is a subclass of brick:Meter. It is defined as: A Waste Meter is used for tracking and categorizing various waste types in a building, aiding in waste management facilitating waste reduction, recycling, and disposal strategies.
brick:Waste_Storage is a class in the schema. Its label is "Waste Storage". It is a subclass of brick:Storage_Room. It is defined as: A room used for storing waste such as trash or recycling

brick:Water_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Alarm. It is defined as: Alarm that indicates an undesirable event with a pipe, container, or equipment carrying water e.g. water leak

brick:Water_Cooled_Chiller is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Cooled Chiller". It is a subclass of brick:Chiller. It is defined as: A chiller system using water in the heat exchange process, employed in industrial or commercial facilities for cooling

brick:Water_Differential_Pressure_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Differential Pressure Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Differential_Pressure_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the difference in water pressure between two points in a system.

brick:Water_Differential_Pressure_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Differential Pressure Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Differential_Pressure_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the target water differential pressure between an upstream and downstream point in a water pipe or conduit

brick:Water_Differential_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Differential Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Temperature_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the difference in water temperature between an upstream and downstream point in a pipe or conduit

brick:Water_Differential_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Differential Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Differential_Temperature_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the target differential temperature between the start and end of a heat transfer cycle in a water circuit

brick:Water_Distribution is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Distribution". It is a subclass of brick:Equipment. It is defined as: Utilize a water distribution source to represent how water is distributed across multiple destinations (pipes)
brick:Water_Flow_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Flow Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Flow_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the rate of flow of water
brick:Water_Flow_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Flow Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Flow_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets the target flow rate of water
brick:Water_Heater is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Heater". It is a subclass of brick:Equipment. It is defined as: An apparatus for heating and usually storing hot water

brick:Water_Level_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Level Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm that indicates a high or low water level e.g. in a basin
brick:Water_Level_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Level Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the height/level of water in some container
brick:Water_Loop is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Loop". It is a subclass of brick:Loop. It is defined as: A collection of equipment that transport and regulate water among each other

brick:Water_Loss_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Loss Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Water_Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm that indicates a loss of water e.g. during transport
brick:Water_Meter is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Meter". It is a subclass of brick:Meter. It is defined as: A meter that measures the usage or consumption of water

brick:Water_Pressure_Reducing_Valve is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Pressure Reducing Valve". It is a subclass of brick:Pressure_Reducing_Valve, brick:Water_Valve. It is defined as: Valve specifically designed to reduce high water pressure to a usable level; maintains uniform water outlet pressure.

brick:Water_Pressure_Relief_Valve is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Pressure Relief Valve". It is a subclass of brick:Pressure_Relief_Valve, brick:Water_Valve. It is defined as: Valve designed to automatically relieve excessive water pressure.

brick:Water_Pressure_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Pressure Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Pressure_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the pressure exerted by water in a system.
brick:Water_Pressure_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Pressure Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Pressure_Setpoint.
brick:Water_Pump is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Pump". It is a subclass of brick:Pump. It is defined as: A pump that performs work on water

brick:Water_Storage_Tank is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Storage Tank". It is a subclass of brick:Storage_Tank. It is defined as: A specialized type of tank intended for the storage of water for extended periods.

brick:Water_System is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water System". It is a subclass of brick:Heating_Ventilation_Air_Conditioning_System. It is defined as: The equipment, devices and conduits that handle the production and distribution of water in a building

brick:Water_Tank is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Tank". It is a subclass of brick:Space. It is defined as: A space used to hold water. This will likely be deprecated in future releases of Brick for the sake of clarity w.r.t. equipment classification of tanks

brick:Water_Temperature_Alarm is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Temperature Alarm". It is a subclass of brick:Temperature_Alarm, brick:Water_Alarm. It is defined as: An alarm that indicates the off-normal conditions associated with temperature of water.
brick:Water_Temperature_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Temperature Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Temperature_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the temperature of water
brick:Water_Temperature_Setpoint is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Temperature Setpoint". It is a subclass of brick:Temperature_Setpoint. It is defined as: Sets temperature of water

brick:Water_Usage_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Usage Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Usage_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the amount of water that is consumed, over some period of time
brick:Water_Valve is a class in the schema. Its label is "Water Valve". It is a subclass of brick:Valve. It is defined as: A valve that modulates the flow of water
brick:Weather_Station is a class in the schema. Its label is "Weather Station". It is a subclass of brick:Equipment. It is defined as: A dedicated weather measurement station

brick:Wind_Direction_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Wind Direction Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Direction_Sensor. It is defined as: Measures the direction of wind in degrees relative to North

brick:Wind_Speed_Sensor is a class in the schema. Its label is "Wind Speed Sensor". It is a subclass of brick:Speed_Sensor. It is defined as: Measured speed of wind, caused by air moving from high to low pressure

brick:Wing is a class in the schema. Its label is "Wing". It is a subclass of brick:Location. It is defined as: A wing is part of a building – or any feature of a building – that is subordinate to the main, central structure.
brick:Wireless_Access_Point is a class in the schema. Its label is "Wireless Access Point". It is a subclass of brick:Data_Network_Equipment.
brick:Workshop is a class in the schema. Its label is "Workshop". It is a subclass of brick:Room. It is defined as: A space used to house equipment that can be used to repair or fabricate things

brick:Zone is a class in the schema. Its label is "Zone". It is a subclass of brick:Location. It is defined as: (1) a separately controlled heated or cooled space. (2) one occupied space or several occupied spaces with similar occupancy category, occupant density, zone air distribution effectiveness, and zone primary airflow per unit area.
